formation: one fully completed UTC hour with exactly 61 consecutive 1m closes / 60 one-minute returns
rv1m: sum of all 60 squared 1m log returns
rv5m: sum of 12 squared 5m log returns formed from the same hour using minute endpoints 04,09,...,59 and the prior hour-end close
direction: fade completed 1h close-to-close return: positive -> SHORT; negative -> LONG
oos_read_policy: do not read 2025+ unless gate passes
